body:
## Problem

The bundled `gh` Agent Skill separately recommends `gh issue view <number> --comments` and exposes `comments` as a JSON field, but it does not state that `--comments` and `--json` cannot be combined. Agents attempting structured issue retrieval can reasonably invoke both and receive:

```
specify only one of --comments or --json
```

## Proposed change

Add one sentence to the issue-reading guidance: for structured issue data including comments, use `--json ...,comments`; use `--comments` only with the human-readable view.

This keeps the existing command reference intact and prevents an avoidable failed call.
title: gh skill: document that issue view --comments and --json are mutually exclusive
